attr.title: Super Star Trek meets 25th Anniversary
attr.desc: This free fan game is a remake/conversion of the 1978 strategy game Super Star Trek reimagined with the UI of the Star Trek 25th Anniversary.
attr.inst: Download the Windows version on itch and copy all game files into the gamedata folder.
attr.inst_md: Download the Windows version on [itch](https://emabolo.itch.io/super-star-trek-25th) and copy all game files into the `gamedata` folder.
